thread:
Priya: Northview POC reported intermittent 503s and big TTFT variance during load test (300-600 rps). They see spikes when multiple clients start in-parallel. Can we triage? :warning:
Sam: do we have request ids and model/route info? Also whether they use multiple connections per client.
Priya: route=/v1/chat, model: redwood-3b-open, variant: quant-c2, sample reqs r_north_001 / r_north_002 / r_north_003
Priya: basic log snippet attached:
Priya: ```
[2026-05-02T14:12:01.102Z] req=r_north_001 route=/v1/chat lat_ms=1400 status=503 batch_size=1 kv_hit=false shard=shard-3
[2026-05-02T14:12:01.210Z] req=r_north_002 route=/v1/chat lat_ms=48 status=200 batch_size=20 kv_hit=true shard=shard-1
[2026-05-02T14:12:02.005Z] req=r_north_003 route=/v1/chat lat_ms=980 status=200 batch_size=1 kv_hit=false shard=shard-3
```
Ravi: 503 + batch_size=1 + kv_hit=false -> sounds like prefill mismatch and shard hot/cold. Are they using a multi-worker gateway that opens N connections per instance? That can break per-connection affinity.
Ivy: Checking metrics for shard-3 now.
Ivy: shard-3 shows CPU steal spikes and high KV eviction rate around those timestamps. eviction_threshold=5m TTL=300s
Sam: two quick mitigations: 1) increase batch_window_ms to 40-60ms to allow batching during burst 2) enable per-client affinity or connection pinning. Either will reduce cold-starts.
Priya: customer currently set batch_window_ms=10ms and prefill_tokens=16. They have a stateless gateway that rounds-robin across connections.
Ravi: suggest immediate test: set batch_window_ms=50 and prefill_tokens=96 for 30 minutes, retest. If 503s persist, scale pool and check eviction settings.
Ivy: running diagnostics:
Ivy: ```
$ redwoodctl pool-stats --pool northview-pool --since 1h
active_shards: 6
avg_kv_hit: 27%
avg_kv_miss_latency_ms: 8.9
cpu_steal: 12% (spikes)
```
Ivy: 27% KV hit explains a lot. Also seeing interleaved variants on shard-3 (quant-c1 and quant-c2) causing cold weights.
Sam: ops plan: 1) temporarily route requests by model-variant to variant-dedicated shards 2) bump batch_window + prefill_tokens 3) ask gateway team to enable keepalive/pinning or use single connection per client.
Priya: customer also asked about pricing if we suggest Dedicated. They want per-token hosted delta and an estimate for a small Dedicated pool for 3b sustained 400 rps.
Pricing-bot: Quick ballpark: hosted unit cost ~0.0009/token equivalent for 3b at that QPS; Dedicated small pool (2 x A100 equiv) amortized ~0.00055/token assuming 70% utilization. Final depends on commit term.
Ravi: ops-bot, can you scale northview-pool by +1 shard and apply eviction TTL bump to 20m for a short window?
Ops-bot: autoscale: northview-pool add_shards=1 (rolling). config_change: kv.eviction_ttl=1200s applied :gear:
Sam: after scale and TTL bump, re-run load and grab traces if any 5xx. Also capture per-request kernel selection and batch trace id.
Priya: after changes customer reran tests: 95% of requests TTFT < 80ms, a few outliers ~600-1200ms but 503s disappeared. Trace id t_north_0502_1428 sent.
Ivy: got trace, looking at kernel logs: slower ones show kernel fallback to generic matmul path at start, then optimized kernel after warming. That aligns with variant mix on shard-3.
Ravi: follow-ups for customer: 1) prefer variant-dedicated routing for POC 2) increase prefill_tokens to 96 for shorter sessions 3) avoid gateway connection churn or enable keepalive pinning.
Priya: I'll update customer with remediation steps and ask if they want a Dedicated trial. Also flag KMS onboarding timeline if they opt for Dedicated (2-3 weeks).
Sam: if they accept Dedicated trial, we'll provision short-term pool and capture SLA targets. Priya, cc me on pricing convo.
Priya: thanks all, closing loop after customer ack. :white_check_mark:
